treatment_method: Wash cotton fabric with deionized water and dry at 60 °C for 1 h before use. Prepare MTP by stirring 50 g phosphoric acid with 20 g tannic acid at 100 °C for 1 h to form tannic phosphate. Disperse 30 g melamine in 500 mL methanol; add tannic phosphate solution dropwise over 30 min, maintain the hot plate at 120 °C and react for 6 h. Filter, wash with methanol, dry at room temperature for 72 h and grind to powder. The source states that the beaker containing deionized water and PVA was heated to 150 °C for 30 min using a hot plate with mechanical stirring at 650 rpm. Whether 150 °C is the actual solution temperature or the hotplate setting is unresolved. PVA molecular weight is 115000 g/mol and degree of polymerization 1700-1800. Add MTP to the PVA solution under continuous stirring at 70 °C; use the Table 1 C7 formulation of 10% PVA and 30% MTP. Soak fabric in the finishing solution at 70 °C for 10 min; pad three times to 90% pickup, dry at 100 °C for 5 min and cure at 160 °C for 3 min. No durability tap-water rinsing is assigned to the initial state.
